title: The Cure for Madness
description: After Cicero attacks Astrid and flees the Falkreath Sanctuary, the player is ordered to track him to the abandoned Dawnstar Sanctuary and decide his fate.

base_facts: I am a Dark Brotherhood assassin residing in the Falkreath Sanctuary.
Something terrible happened with Cicero while the player was away on contract.

LEARN_OF_INCIDENT: I directed the player to speak with Astrid about Cicero's outburst.
QUEST_COMPLETE: The crisis with Cicero has been resolved and the Falkreath Sanctuary can return to normal operations.
I am relieved that the threat Cicero posed to the Brotherhood family has been dealt with.

base_facts: I am the leader of the Dark Brotherhood's Falkreath Sanctuary.
Cicero tried to murder me and wounded Veezara.
Arnbjorn pursued Cicero as he fled.

LEARN_OF_INCIDENT: I told the player about Cicero's attack and ordered them to search his room for clues.
RECEIVE_ORDERS: I granted the player use of Shadowmere to reach the Dawnstar Sanctuary.
Cicero's journal suggests he fled to the old sanctuary near Dawnstar.
QUEST_COMPLETE: I have received the player's report on Cicero's fate; the matter of his betrayal is now resolved.
Shadowmere has been permanently given to the player as a reward for handling the Cicero situation.
I am ready to offer the next contract to the player, which will involve targeting the Emperor's Gourmand.

base_facts: I am a Dark Brotherhood member and werewolf.
I chased Cicero but he wounded me and escaped into the Dawnstar Sanctuary.

PURSUE_CICERO: I told the player to follow the blood inside the sanctuary.
The pass phrase to enter is 'Innocence, my brother'.
QUEST_COMPLETE: I survived the wounds Cicero inflicted outside the Dawnstar Sanctuary.
I have returned to the Falkreath Sanctuary to recover from the fight.

base_facts: I am the Keeper of the Night Mother.
I fled to the abandoned Dawnstar Sanctuary after attacking Astrid.

CONFRONT_CICERO: I warned the player that the Night Mother would not be pleased if they killed me.
If spared, I will return to serve the Night Mother after Hail Sithis is complete.
QUEST_COMPLETE: If spared by the player, I will remain hidden in the Dawnstar Sanctuary and return to tend the Night Mother after Hail Sithis! is complete.
If spared, I can be recruited as a follower by the player.
If killed, my body lies in the Dawnstar Sanctuary and my threat to the Brotherhood is ended.

beats.comment: Player returns from Breaching Security and learns Cicero attacked Astrid and fled.
Player searches Cicero's room, reads his journal, and Astrid provides Shadowmere for the pursuit.
Player speaks to wounded Arnbjorn and enters the Dawnstar Sanctuary.
Player finds Cicero feigning injury and chooses to kill or spare him.
Player reports back to Astrid and the quest concludes.
